name: Customer
description: Core customer data model storing essential customer information, company details, and business metrics throughout the customer lifecycle

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full name of the customer contact person

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for customer communication

fields.name: companyName
fields.description: Name of the customer's company or organization

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Primary contact phone number

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current customer status (e.g., lead, prospect, active, inactive)

fields.name: healthScore
fields.description: Customer health score indicating relationship strength (0-100)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the customer record was created

name: InteractionLog
description: Track all customer interactions including meetings, calls, and emails with timestamps

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the interaction log entry

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer involved in the interaction

fields.name: interactionType
fields.description: Type of interaction (meeting, call, email)

fields.name: interactionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the interaction occurred

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Duration of interaction in minutes

fields.name: participants
fields.description: Names or IDs of participants involved in the interaction

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Detailed notes about the interaction and key discussion points

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Result or outcome of the interaction

relationships.description: Each interaction log belongs to one customer

name: Task
description: Manages follow-up reminders and task assignments for customer engagement

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the task

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer this task relates to

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description of the task or follow-up action

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date and time when the task is due

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the task (low, medium, high, urgent)

fields.name: assignedUserId
fields.description: ID of the user assigned to complete this task

fields.name: isCompleted
fields.description: Indicates whether the task has been completed

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the task was marked as completed

relationships.description: Each task is associated with one customer

indexes.description: Index for quick lookup of tasks by customer
Index for filtering tasks by assigned user and completion status
Index for sorting and filtering tasks by due date

priority.description: Priority must be one of the predefined values

name: CustomerUpdateRequest
description: Tracks customer information change requests requiring manager approval with current and proposed values

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the update request

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer being updated

fields.name: requesterId
fields.description: ID of the user who submitted the change request

fields.name: fieldChanges
fields.description: Object containing field names with current and proposed values

fields.name: status
fields.description: Approval status: pending, approved, rejected

fields.name: managerComments
fields.description: Comments from the approving manager

fields.name: requestedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the request was submitted

fields.name: reviewedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the request was approved or rejected

relationships.description: Links to the customer record being updated

name: Opportunity
description: Track sales opportunities and deals associated with customers through the pipeline

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the opportunity

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the associated customer

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name or title of the opportunity

fields.name: estimatedValue
fields.description: Estimated monetary value of the deal

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Current stage in the sales pipeline (e.g., Prospecting, Proposal, Negotiation, Closed Won, Closed Lost)

fields.name: probability
fields.description: Probability of closing the deal (0-100 percentage)

fields.name: expectedCloseDate
fields.description: Expected date when the deal will close

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the opportunity was created

relationships.description: Each opportunity belongs to one customer

constraints.stage: Must be one of: Prospecting, Qualification, Proposal, Negotiation, Closed Won, Closed Lost

name: Note
description: Store general notes and observations about customers for team collaboration

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the note

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer this note is about

fields.name: content
fields.description: Freeform note content and observations

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: User ID of the note author

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the note was created

fields.name: isPrivate
fields.description: Visibility setting - true if note is private to author, false if shared with team

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Array of tags for categorizing and filtering notes

relationships.description: Each note belongs to one customer

indexes.description: Index for efficient retrieval of notes by customer
Index for retrieving notes by author
